pages.text: The Kleis Dominion Wand turns a machine face into a wireless virtual logistics endpoint without placing a node. Hold the wand in the main hand and a configured Sky Configurator in the offhand. Right-click creates an insert face, sneak-right-click creates an extract face, and right-clicking an existing virtual face removes it. Virtual endpoints can route across loaded dimensions without a Dimension Upgrade.

pages.title: Copy and Paste
pages.text: Swap hands so the configurator is in the main hand and the wand is in the offhand. Nearby virtual faces are highlighted. Sneak-right-click a highlighted face to copy its single-face settings and enter paste mode. Right-click another highlighted face to paste. You can also copy a real logistics node and paste its active-face settings to a virtual face, or copy a virtual face and paste it to a real node.

The copied settings include line, extract/insert mode, enabled resources, priority, limits, filters, and supported upgrades. Virtual faces always ignore redstone, and their redstone button is disabled. Pasting never creates free upgrades. A virtual endpoint ignores Dimension Upgrades because cross-dimensional routing is built in. Only loaded machine faces operate; the wand never loads chunks.
